chunks: He is the Lord of the East and the West. There is no god but He. So take Him alone as your protector.

key_terms.لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ: There is no god but He

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to take Allah as a Wakil (Protector)?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Muzzammil emphasizes Tawhid al-Rububiyyah by affirming Allah's sovereignty over all directions, serving as a foundation for spiritual reliance (Tawakkul). The command to 'take Him as a guardian' (Wakīl) is often linked to the Prophet's and Imams' deep trust in divine protection amidst adversity, highlighting the practical implication of seeking refuge solely in God.
